title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file on config.rs
description: patch_file returned 'old_string not found' on src/moeb/src/config.rs. Cause: CRLF line endings on Windows. Recovered via write_file fallback with complete file content. No intended change was lost.
proposed_resolution: Verify that moeb.patch-file-crlf-normalize CRLF normalization covers the exact-string replacement path introduced by moeb.patch-file-exact-string-rewrite.

title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file on query_agent.rs
description: patch_file returned 'old_string not found' on src/moeb/src/tools/query_agent.rs. Cause: CRLF line endings on Windows. Recovered via write_file fallback.
proposed_resolution: Verify that moeb.patch-file-crlf-normalize CRLF normalization covers the exact-string replacement path.

title: patch_file CRLF normalization incomplete in exact-string mode
description: Two patch_file calls failed with 'old_string not found' on Windows CRLF files in this run. moeb.patch-file-crlf-normalize added normalize_line_endings but moeb.patch-file-exact-string-rewrite replaced the diff engine with exact substring matching, which may not apply the same normalization. Result: patch_file is unreliable on Windows for files with CRLF endings, requiring write_file fallback on every affected file.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to verify and extend CRLF normalization to the exact-string matching path in patch_file.rs, ensuring both old_string and file content are normalized before the substring search.

title: Missing moeb tool: Read (large tool output)
description: The start_spec tool consistently returns results exceeding the inline response limit (~140K characters), saved to disk. An external Read tool is required to access this content in chunks on every spec run. No moeb tool exists for reading harness-saved large tool result files.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a moeb tool (e.g. read_tool_result) that accepts a saved tool result path and returns it in paginated chunks, eliminating the need for external Read calls on oversized tool outputs.

title: Missing moeb tool: Bash (cargo_test)
description: Used Bash to run cargo build --release and cargo test in src/moeb/ for build and test verification. No moeb tool exists for executing the project test suite, forcing moeb-tool-origin Fail.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a run_tests tool that executes cargo test in a specified directory and returns the result.
